requirements.statement: Establish one authoritative redesign document defining the North Star, Codex/KEEL ownership boundary, canonical primitives, orthogonal state dimensions, single dependency graph, and all requested authorization, resource, evidence, verification, hook, runtime-trust, compatibility, and semantic-authority invariants.

Classify every landed component family at file-level granularity as PRESERVE, REWORK, REMOVE-AFTER-MIGRATION, or MOVE-OUT-OF-CORE, and define deterministic compatibility and staged migration gates without implementing them.
Freeze feature expansion above landed P2 and make existing audit/roadmap authorities explicitly subordinate for future redesign work without rewriting historical evidence.
Make the migration authority mechanically discoverable from primary architecture and documentation navigation and record a subordinate planning-only ExecPlan.
